answers.core: This is a core condition of how the engine operates in headless mode and lies within the abstraction layer of the engine.
answers.workaround:
No, there needs to be a handling structure to asign network authority specifically to only one existing client.
This also introduces a necessary peer to peer structure into games that might want to be entirely server client, which may cause instability and further networking problems.
